instruction: A candid documentary wide shot from a high angle captures an indoor training studio with a red carpet and white walls. On the left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on her left leg, executing a high front kick with her right leg. On the right, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing her, catching her extended right foot with both hands. The interaction is captured in full body view. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent lights, creating a neutral color palette with soft shadows on the red carpet.
